dataset.caveat: The committed benchmark CSV is synthetic. Congestion Level is a deterministic function of Travel Time Index (45.0159*TTI - 45.0286, R^2=0.999976 over 57,600 rows) on a complete 24-corridor x 100-day x 24-hour grid with zero missing values. Accuracy on it measures the generator's regularity, not real Bengaluru traffic, and must always be reported with these baselines.

methodology: All metrics are computed on the out-of-time test partition (dates >= split_date). The lookup baseline is the mode of Future_Congestion per (road_id, hour, congestion_level) learned on train rows, with global-mode fallback for unseen combinations.

majority_class.description: Predict the most frequent future class from the training partition.

persistence.description: Predict that next hour's class equals the current observed class.

lookup_road_hour_current_los.description: Mode of Future_Congestion per (road, derived hour, current LOS) learned on train rows; unseen combinations fall back to the global mode.
